cell.label: Pregnant or breastfeeding woman* or child younger than 8 y?
Use 3-drug regimen: doxycycline plus rifampin for 6 wk plus an aminoglycoside for 2 wk.
Consider other diagnoses such as tuberculosis, typhoid, malaria, autoimmune disorders, etc.
Brucellosis suspected. Order serum agglutination test or direct culture.

footnotes.footnote: Brucellosis suspected. Order serum agglutination test or direct culture.

Two-drug regimens have significantly higher failure rates than 3-drug regimens. Pregnant women may be treated with a 3-drug regimen if counseled about potential risk to fetus. Breastfeeding women should stop breastfeeding when possible.

Data from Skalsky K, Yahav D, Bishara J, Pillik S, Loibovici L, Paul M. Treatment of human brucellosis: systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trial. BMJ. 2008;336:701-704; and Bossi P, Tegnell A, Baka A, et al. Bichat guidelines for the clinical management of brucellosis and bioterrorism-related brucellosis. Euro Surveill. 2004;9:E15-6.
